verdict.rationale: Xero has an extensive public API, OpenAPI spec, SDK with 'full method coverage' for API sets, and even an MCP server exposing core objects (contacts, invoices, chart of accounts), showing broad programmatic access. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of 1:1 UI/API parity, and several UI-highlighted AI features (JAX reconciliation/invoicing, benchmarking, dashboards) aren't confirmed as API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, evidence that newer AI/UI-only features are API-exposed, and independent confirmation of full coverage.
